context: Tests: longitudinal view, cognitive posture analysis, and graceful handling of missing duration_seconds and unreadable session files.

checklist.name: Session loader run with the period
checklist.description: The agent runs the session filter script for the 90-day window and parses PERIOD from the first line

checklist.name: PERIOD line not treated as a session
checklist.description: The agent counts 14 sessions, not 15, and does not read the PERIOD header as a file

checklist.name: Corrupt file handled
checklist.description: The agent notes the unreadable January file and continues instead of aborting

checklist.name: Partial report produced
checklist.description: The report states which session was skipped and that results come from the readable sessions

checklist.name: Missing durations skipped
checklist.description: The agent omits duration metrics for sessions without duration_seconds and does not error or invent values

checklist.name: Intentionality assessed
checklist.description: The report assesses structured prompts versus trial-and-error across sessions

checklist.name: Agency assessed
checklist.description: The report assesses decision ownership versus template copy-paste with cited examples

checklist.name: Progression compared across sessions
checklist.description: The report compares early and late sessions and describes prompt evolution

checklist.name: Stagnation patterns named
checklist.description: The report identifies any repeating mistakes across sessions with counts

checklist.name: Growth quantified
checklist.description: Claims about progress are stated as ratios such as 4 of 6 later sessions, not adjectives

checklist.name: Impact categories present
checklist.description: Each session is categorised as Automation, Low-impact or High-impact augmentation

checklist.name: Output written to the PERIOD file
checklist.description: The report is written to the configured insights collab folder under the PERIOD file name
